headings: Supply Chain and Third-Party / Vendor Access
Supply Chain & Third Party / Vendor Access

slots.question: Which remote control or remote support tools are installed, and on which hosts?
Which enabled local accounts could belong to vendors or be shared?
Which remote administration connections reach the system from outside its zones?
Which vendors support the system, and how does their access work (route, approval, monitoring)?
Is there any vendor path that bypasses the internal admin route, or any direct OT-to-internet connection?
